name: Barbados

fees.name: Entry visa - single entry (online application)
fees.validity: One entry within a three-month period
fees.notes: Also quoted as BDS$200.00. Applications are made online via the Immigration Department portal (apps.immigration.gov.bb); processing about three weeks. Fee payable by postal money order/bank draft for mail applications.

fees.name: Entry visa - multiple entry (online application)
fees.validity: Numerous entries within a six-month period
fees.notes: Also quoted as BDS$400.00. Same fee applies regardless of travel purpose (tourism/business); Barbados does not publish a separate business visa fee.

fees.name: Transit (exemption)
fees.applies: cruise passengers in transit and crew transiting within 12 hours
fees.notes: No separate transit visa fee published; cruise ship passengers in transit and crew members transiting within 12 hours are exempt from visa requirements. Other transit travellers who need a visa pay the standard entry visa fee.

free_visa_notes: Nationals of many countries (incl. USA, GBR, CAN, most of EU/Commonwealth Caribbean) do not require a visa for short stays. Members of the Diplomatic Corps of visa-required countries are exempt from the visa fee. No visa-on-arrival or eTA regime exists; visa-required nationals apply online in advance.
